response.sql: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(*) AS ballot_count FROM hall_of_fame AS h JOIN player AS p ON h.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ballot_count) AS avg_count FROM state_counts) SELECT AVG(s.ballot_count) AS average_count, AVG(s.ballot_count - o.avg_count) AS average_excess FROM state_counts AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.ballot_count > o.avg_count
